# Philippines

> [!summary] Data available
> The Philippines are well represented in dish inventories (WorldCuisines 133, FmLAMA 55, World Wide Dishes 33) and have a Tagalog BLEnD culture, but few recipes and no processed FCT. Start with [[WorldCuisines]], [[World Wide Dishes]] and [[BLEnD]] (Q1) and [[KNApSAcK Family]] (Q3).

## Foods & dishes
- Inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 133 dishes (95 Philippines-only); [[FmLAMA]] 55; [[World Wide Dishes]] 33 (32 Philippines-only). Ingredients, no amounts.
- [[BLEnD]]: 105 food questions (Tagalog_Philippines), 373 answer clusters.
- Recipes: [[RecipeDB2]] ≈540 "Filipino" (v1); [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 206.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Philippine Food Composition Tables]] (~1,600 foods incl. dishes; candidate, priority 2); [[ASEAN Food Composition Database]] (priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
[[KNApSAcK Family]] 963 records (482 edible / 481 medicinal); [[CMAUP]] 269 plants; [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 752 records, 425 taxa; [[NPASS]] 79 pairs. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No recipes with amounts from Philippine sources, no FCT processed, no Filipino herbal-medicine database.
